summary: Participation (Phase 1): the machinery for Nora to speak in a room without being tagged — occasion-gated, per-room opt-in, with the right to stay silent. Ships disabled.
details: design/dreamer-agent-loop/35, Phase 1: a fifth fire-path Event kind, 'participation'. An untagged message in a room the operator opted in (`participation = true` on its policy.toml entry) is noted; once the room goes quiet for `[participation] settle_seconds` (default 10), exactly one determination runs through the same FirePath, guards, audit and delivery machinery every occasion uses.

The determination runs with tool_choice=auto and the new participation-conduct doctrine: no grounded value = silence, and silence is a success, counted on its own series (`nora_participation_silence_total` / `nora_participation_spoke_total`) and never charged to the tag audience's silent-failure budget.

Cadence is a SEND cooldown, not an evaluation cooldown: at most one participation message per room per `[participation] cooldown_minutes` (default 10), enforced at the Deliverer; a tag holding the conversation slot makes the window skip silently, never queue.

R-1's second clause was revised for the first time: ambient traffic reaches the agent ONLY through this gating. R-1b is untouched — participation speaks through FirePath.speak, so deliver.build still has exactly two callers.
limitations: Inert as shipped: `[participation] enabled = false` by default, and even enabled it engages nowhere until a room is individually opted in via policy.toml.
No live-send rollout and no shadow/mirror channel in this phase — that is Phase 2 (design §8). Phase 1 lands the occasion, the gating, the metrics and the rule sweep only.
